source: Exact-image IDA producer/consumer audit, detailed report /tmp/astrolink-p65-bluelet-wake.md and Astrolink native-publication report.

verified.abi: Five args owner/run/cancel/argument in R0..R3, event byte at incomingSP+0. Consumer0xC98FC1E calls run(owner,event,argument). Final1 is event, not wake flag.
verified.publication: Producer0xC98FDD0 locks mutex*0x3C492754; writes owner+0,arg+4,run+8,cancel+12,event+16 before publishing write index0xC98FE3E. External ring blocks408 bytes with20 records.
verified.wake: Empty-to-nonempty path0xC98FEB4 loads semaphore*0x3C492750;0xC98FEB8 calls0xC9A252C -> NuttX sem_post0xC4C7178. Consumer0xC98FBE0 waits on same semaphore at0xC98FD66 ->0xC9A251C ->0xC4C6BE0 when local and external queues empty.
verified.ownership: Argument retained for run/cancel and never freed by queue. Uninitialized mutex invokes cancel(0,221,argument) synchronously. Normal return is unlock semaphore result, unavailable return is cancel result; callback remains authoritative.
verified.stock_consumers: Cross-task producers0xC98ED24,0xC98ED50,0xC98A2E4 call0xC98FDD0. Bluelet entry0xCB8D85C calls consumer0xC98FBE0 at0xCB8D866.
verified.rejected_old_entry: 0x1C1676C8 ->0xC98FD8C inserts owner-local list0x3C492740 without mutex or semaphore. It publishes links before record fields and returns record pointer. Safe only under owner serialization, not a cross-task queue.
